title: Short-horizon Duesenberry Equilibrium
abstract: arXiv:2603.16108v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop a continuous-time general equilibrium framework for an infinite heterogeneous population whose household types are transported by a Brownian flow. Agents repeatedly solve short-horizon optimization problems over state-price-discounted consumption and wealth, which admit an endogenous relative-income criterion in equilibrium. For the resulting Radner-type equilibrium---a short-horizon Duesenberry equilibrium---we obtain a complete characterization and an existence theorem; market completeness and the absence of state-tame arbitrage emerge endogenously from market clearing.   Finally, the equity premium puzzle is shifted to a question about the volatility of aggregate total wealth, while the risk-free rate puzzle admits a plausible resolution.

translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.16108v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们为无限异质人口群体开发了一个连续时间的一般均衡框架，其中家庭类型通过布朗流进行传输。代理人反复解决短期优化问题，涉及状态价格贴现的消费和财富，这在均衡中内生地产生了一个相对收入准则。对于由此产生的拉德纳型均衡——即短视杜森贝利均衡——我们获得了完整的刻画和存在性定理；市场完备性和无状态驯服套利的缺失从市场出清中内生地涌现。最后，股权溢价之谜被转化为关于总财富波动性的问题，而无风险利率之谜则得到了一个合理的解释。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种新的连续时间一般均衡模型，通过内生相对收入准则和短视优化，解决了市场完备性、无套利以及股权溢价和无风险利率之谜。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel continuous-time general equilibrium model with endogenous relative-income criteria and short-horizon optimization, resolving market completeness, absence of arbitrage, and offering insights into the equity premium and risk-free rate puzzles.
